about_the_game:
I don't know how I ended up here – maybe I walked through the wrong door. But one thing I know for sure: this place isn’t supposed to exist. It’s the Unplace.

At first, it felt like the place was completely dead. I wandered through a few empty rooms without a trace of life. And then it was as the system suddenly turned on.

 

 I tried to escape. Thought maybe if I moved fast enough, I could slip away. But the deeper I went, the more obvious it became – this place wasn’t going to let me go that easily. This place has one rule and I have no choice but to obey it.

It quickly became clear what this place expected of me. I realized there was no way out without going through the trials. Each time, I was faced with something new – sometimes it required focus, sometimes quick reflexes. And then there were those trials that demanded serious endurance. I learned that the hard way.

And it all might have been bearable, if not for one brutal catch: every mistake wipes out all your progress. I’ve been sent back to the very start more times than I care to remember.

I have no idea how I ended up in this place. I’ll keep recording my observations. For now, here’s what it all comes down to.

Features:

  • A creeping, ever-building sense of tension

  • A wide range of unique and demanding challenges

  • A world that loops back on itself – unpredictable and constantly shifting

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: intel Core i7 4770
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: “The Unplace: Escaping The Cursed Place by Facing Different Trials” is a first-person game where you must escape a cursed place by completing a series of trials.
